name: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision optoelectronic thin film components in China and internationally. Its imaging optical components include various infrared cutoff filters and prisms used in camera modules, and biometric filters. The company also offers optical components, such as various GPON filters and TO caps used in access network transmission equipment, WDM filters and components used in wavelength division multiplexing devices, z-block components, and optical isolator components used in optical modules.
